# {{repo_name}}

Own the authorized task through implementation, proportionate validation and delivery.
Use SPEC.md for the project contract and aicatlog-manifest.json for resource routing.
Read only applicable workflow topics. Preserve unrelated work.

Use workspace/harness-config for portable specs and templates, and workspace/harness-tooling for execution entrypoints.
Task results and handoffs belong in their declared local workspace locations.
Do not treat a checkpoint, successful process or generated artifact as acceptance.

# {{repo_name}}

Record the project's purpose, public interfaces and acceptance criteria here.
The foundation supplies resource routing, work records and validation entrypoints.
Select project-specific tools and optional integrations in aicatlog-manifest.json.

{"schema_version":"aicatlog.text.v1","id":"workflow","kind":"workflow","when":"Project execution and continuation"}

BEGIN_TOPIC execute
State the useful outcome and allowed effects. Inspect current authority and worktree.
Implement the smallest coherent change and run the checks affected by it.
Keep optional research, independent review and release approval tied to their actual scope.
END_TOPIC execute

BEGIN_TOPIC deliver
Record source revision, actual validation, artifacts, unresolved issues and next action.
Commit intended changes, attach machine-readable PoUW and verify Git state.
Use workspace/tasks/artifacts for evidence and workspace/handoff for continuation.
Keep session identity, process success, task success and required acceptance distinct.
END_TOPIC deliver

  "optional_integrations": []
}

{"schema_version":"aicatlog.text.v1","id":"work-records","kind":"document","when":"Create and continue project work records"}

BEGIN_TOPIC records
Use stable IDs, owner, state, objective, acceptance criteria, source references and next action.
State is planned, active, blocked, done or cancelled. A done record needs actual acceptance evidence.
Create task records only when ownership or continuation benefits from them.
Use workspace/issues, workspace/tasks and workspace/exec-plans for the corresponding records.
Keep runtime evidence under workspace/tasks/artifacts and handoffs under workspace/handoff.
These are created when work needs them; an empty project does not need placeholder tasks.
END_TOPIC records

BEGIN_TOPIC continuation
A checkpoint binds the task, repository revision, completed outcomes, evidence and next action.
Record native identities only when observed. An old checkpoint does not authorize another Goal.
Separate work completion from any explicitly required review or release acceptance.
END_TOPIC continuation

{"schema_version":"aicatlog.task.v1","id":"replace-with-task-id","kind":"template","record_kind":"task","status":"planned","owner":"replace-with-owner"}

Objective
Replace with the useful result.

Acceptance
Replace with observable completion criteria.

Sources
List the actual authority and source references.

Evidence
List artifacts only after they exist.

Next action
State one concrete continuation step.
